{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the actual values in severity (case-sensitive)
print("Unique severity values in deduplicated dataset:", max_sample_seq['severity'].unique())

# Use case-insensitive filter
severe_df = max_sample_seq[max_sample_seq['severity'].str.upper() == 'SEVERE']

# Check number of SEVERE patients
print("Number of SEVERE patients (case-insensitive):", len(severe_df))

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker_severe"}
